references.text: God commanded Israel not to attack the Ammonites, since their land was given as a possession to Lot's descendants.
The origin of the Ammonites as descendants of Lot, which explains why Israel should not take their land.
The Jabbok River is mentioned as the boundary of the Ammonite territory.
The Jabbok River is described as the border against the Ammonites in connection with the distribution of the land.
Jephthah refers to Israel's respect for the Ammonite borders at the Jabbok when they came from Egypt.
The Jabbok River is confirmed as the boundary against the Ammonites when land was allotted to Reuben and Gad.
